intro.text: A noble house of the Final Empire, seventh in power among the ten Great Houses of Luthadel.
A noble house of Scadrial: seventh of Luthadel's ten Great Houses in the Final Empire, and still a noble house in Elendel.

items.text: Erikell sold swords and dueling canes to its ally House Venture, while selling the same arms a little cheaper to House Tekiel. Posing as a street informant, Kelsier told Straff Venture an exaggerated version of this, hoping to split Venture from Erikell.
Chip Erikell, a smuggler in Elendel's Third Octant, is among those killed at Winsting Innate's auction.
Lord Erikell, head of the house, attends Lady ZoBell's party and talks with Governor Replar Innate.
When a water tower falls on the church during Wax and Steris's wedding, an Erikell insurance assessor argues with a priest over paying out the policy.
Cash meant for Erikell's payroll is among the money the Nightstreet Gang takes when it robs a train bound for New Seran.

The house stays powerful, with interests in arms and insurance and friends among high officials. It sides with House Hasting, and is tied to Melstrom, a senator for Elendel's dockworkers, through a bribery scandal.
